product_summary: Company's own storefront mydentalshop.in (powered by M R Dental (India) Pvt Ltd, address 501 Sachdeva Corporate Tower, Karkardooma, New Delhi 110092) lists 31 SKUs: acrylic artificial teeth sets (Medi-Cryl II anteriors/posteriors/full sets, V Cryl three-layer, V Lux, Medi-Lux), denture base polymers (Heat Cure Powder/Liquid, High Impact Powder, Rapid Repair Powder, Crown & Bridge Self-Cure Resin, Flexible Denture Material), PMMA Medi Disc CAD/CAM blanks, Alginate Chromatic impression material, dental cotton rolls, denture boxes, light-cure trays. About page states ISO 13485:2016 certified, CDSCO licensed, established 2017, PMMA technology focus. Source: https://www.mydentalshop.in/collections/all and https://www.mydentalshop.in/pages/about-us (accessed via http_get).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared 'premier Indian manufacturer' of PMMA dental materials, ISO 13485 + CDSCO licence claimed); also acts as a marketplace/reseller for 'multiple reputed dental brands' — so manufacturer_trader is plausible. No customs line available to confirm export activity; all shipment/volume claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS 901849 is a partial match only. 9018.49 covers dental instruments and appliances (drills, handpieces, mirrors, forceps) — the company's actual core output is artificial teeth (9021.21) and denture base polymers/PMMA (9021.29 / 3906.10), plus impression materials (3506.10) and lab consumables (3926.90, 3005.90). The declared single code therefore under-describes the range and points at the wrong subheading for the flagship product. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the actual product mix, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry field 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a clear misclassification — the company is a dental materials / medical-device manufacturer; the only chemical link is PMMA/MMA polymer handling, which does not justify the oil & gas label. Trader signs: the About page explicitly says the shop is 'expanding to include products from multiple reputed dental brands', i.e. resale of third-party brands alongside own manufacture — a mixed manufacturer/trader profile. Product lines missing from the declaration: artificial teeth, PMMA discs, alginates, cotton rolls, denture boxes, flexible denture material. Note on the name cluster: the batch lists 'MEADWAY DENTALS PRIVATE LIMITED' together with M R Dental (India) Pvt Ltd; no public page was found linking Meadway Dentals to this catalogue (search backend was down, direct domain lookup failed), so the Meadway product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — cannot_verify. No customs/B-L line was available in this task, so no product here is corroborated by a shipment record; all mapping rests on the company's own website, i.e. 'заявлено, не подтверждено' as to actual shipments. Revenue, export volumes, PAN, CIN and registry status were out of scope and not researched.
